title: Caution sign.
officialText: A sign stating, “Louvers, dampers and/or ventilation openings must not be blocked or disabled.” shall be permanently affixed, in clear view, and adjacent to the opening(s) within the room containing the equipment. The letters used on the sign shall be at least 1 inch (25 mm) in height.
